entities.summary: Belgium is a sovereign nation in Western Europe, Europe. Its capital is Brussels. Official languages include Dutch (Flemish), French, German. Government: Federal parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 11.7 million. Area: 30,528 km². Comprehensive index for Belgium covering Gallia Belgica (Caesar 'bravest of all Gauls'), Frankish kingdoms, Burgundian Netherlands, Habsburg rule, Spanish Netherlands, Austrian Netherlands, French Revolution annexation, Congress of Vienna 1815 (United Kingdom of Netherlands), Belgian Revolution 1830, Leopold I, Congo Free State (Leopold II, 1885-1908, genocide ~10M killed), WWI Western Front (Ypres, Flanders Fields, Belgian neutrality violated), WWII German occupation, EU/NATO headquarters (Brussels), linguistic divide (Flemish-Walloon), and federal devolution.
